refs.mapping: Owner confirmed visible content: A=5.44.46 PM short through-ball; B=5.36.19 PM long ordinary passes.
refs.method: Full clips played at 1x; extracted every third frame (20 Hz), inspected ordered sequences and original-pixel crops. Manual ball centres; median local grass-patch phase correlation estimates camera translation. Approximate 50–70 horizontal pixels/metre at ball depth from penalty-area 16.5 m depth and centre-circle 18.3 m diameter. NOT a solved camera homography; depth motion, zoom, grass texture and occlusion broaden bounds. Physical pitch dimensions are geometric assumptions, not source metadata.

through.direct: Ball is already travelling at first frame; chasing runner closes the visible gap and meets it near the penalty-area edge. Observation timestamps are exact to frame sampling; touch time bracket is visual.
through.absoluteDeceleration: Early observed loss is stronger than late in the rough camera-corrected estimate; cannot establish an increasingly large absolute deceleration. Increasing catchability is directly visible. Tune a progressively dying feel, not a claimed exact source force law.
through.height: Near-turf throughout observable interval; ball/shadow separation small. Exact clearance, discrete contact times and angular velocity cannot be recovered reliably. No clear large bounce.
through.spin: Unresolved; no defensible direction or rad/s.

normal.direct: Several crisply struck free passes separated by dribble/receiving touches. First free pass is the main comparison; later passes cross-check that short and medium lengths do not look identical.
normal.texture: Small nonuniform ball/shadow disturbances; approximately one to three possible low disturbances in the main pass. Contact count is NOT confidently resolved; feet, shadow displacement, compression and camera motion confound subpixel vertical movement.
normal.lateSlowdown: Observed only until receiving touch. Natural rest is not shown, so terminal slowdown is a gameplay constraint rather than a measured source property.
normal.spin: Ball markings not resolved well enough for angular velocity.
